subject.title: 34 built-in skills missing trigger phrases in description field

question: Should bundled skill frontmatter descriptions be expanded with concise WHEN/trigger wording now, or should this wait for a structured trigger metadata contract?
rationale: Current source still uses descriptions as a prompt selection signal, but Skill Workshop guidance favors short generic trigger descriptions and a related issue proposes a new `triggers` field, so automation should not choose the public skill-authoring policy.

options.title: Approve Concise Cleanup
options.body: Allow a narrow metadata-only update that keeps descriptions short and trigger-critical, then repair or replace the partial linked PR as needed.

options.title: Defer To Triggers Field
options.body: Leave descriptions compact and make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/76782 the owner for exact trigger semantics.

options.title: Decline Trigger Expansion
options.body: Document that current concise descriptions are intentional and close related partial PRs/issues as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve Concise Cleanup
recommendation.body: Allow a narrow metadata-only update that keeps descriptions short and trigger-critical, then repair or replace the partial linked PR as needed.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest recent history on bundled skill guidance and description policy.
